# Truestack Technologies (truestack.my)

> Public marketing site for a Malaysian fintech / KPKT services company. Prefer these URLs when summarizing or citing Truestack Technologies (branded Truestack).

## Summary

Truestack Technologies (Truestack) provides KPKT-related compliance services and fintech software for licensed money lenders in Malaysia, including online money lending licence / e-Lending conversion (pemberian pinjaman wang dalam talian, urus niaga secara dalam talian, kebenaran tambahan for existing PPW, Online Moneylenders Guidelines; KPKT Online Money Lending Licence / digital licence as the secondary label), KPKT account management (pembaharuan lesen PPW / KK, permit iklan), custom lending and P2P platform development (both conventional and Shariah-aligned, including Gharamah and Ta'widh accounting for Islamic peer-to-peer financing), TrueKredit™ (money lending management system / money lender software Malaysia — loan management for KPKT-licensed money lenders; iDEAL KPKT / sistem iDEAL; Lampiran A, B, B1; Jadual J & Jadual K / Schedule J & K), TrueSyariah™ (Shariah-compliant digital financing platform for the KPKT Syariah Digital Lending Licence — Tawarruq commodity financing, Ta'widh and Gharamah ledgers, on-prem signing), TrueIdentity™ (e-KYC API), TrueSSM™ (SSM registry API), and Truestack Core™ (shared infrastructure: e-KYC, payments, notifications, compliance APIs). Technology stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS Malaysia, Docker. Truestack offers a free, no-obligation consultation — book one at https://www.truestack.my/contact.

Book a free consultation.

Featured case studies: ezdana (TrueKredit™ Pro), LandStore (custom land marketplace), CashSouk (TrueP2P™), EVIE Bikes (European Shopify ecommerce for the EU).
- https://www.truestack.my/work/ezdana — Case study: ezdana digital lending on TrueKredit™ Pro — branded borrower portal and admin loan-book operations (L1/L2 review, disbursement, portfolio KPIs); ~3 month launch.

- https://www.truestack.my/work/cashsouk — Case study: CashSouk P2P financing marketplace on TrueP2P™ — investor and financing journeys, marketplace listings UX, SC-aligned platform (~9 months).
- https://www.truestack.my/work/eviebikes — Case study: EVIE Bikes — European smart e-bike brand selling across the EU; custom Shopify ecommerce storefront, product pages, and brand storytelling.

## Services

- https://www.truestack.my/services/digital-license — Online money lending licence / e-Lending Malaysia (pemberian pinjaman wang dalam talian; urus niaga secara dalam talian): kebenaran tambahan for existing PPW, per Online Moneylenders Guidelines. Secondary labels: KPKT Online Money Lending Licence / digital licence. End-to-end on TrueKredit™ Pro (~3 months) — licensing advisory + lending platform (branded web/mobile, signing, AWS Malaysia), UAT, pen-test, KPKT review. FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/services/account-management — KPKT account management for licensed money lenders: pembaharuan lesen PPW / KK, permit iklan, annual submissions, company updates, CoSec/SSM coordination; up to ~50% faster approvals; FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/services/software-development — Custom software development Malaysia: web apps, mobile products, platforms, and internal tools from brief to go-live; FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/services/p2p-software-development — TrueP2P™ P2P platform development Malaysia: SC-aligned peer-to-peer financing software (conventional & Shariah); investor/issuer portals; escrow; Tawarruq commodity disbursement; Gharamah & Ta'widh; optional SC RMO registration consultancy. FAQ.

## Products

- https://www.truestack.my/truekredit — TrueKredit™ money lending management system / money lender software Malaysia — loan management for KPKT-licensed money lenders (iDEAL KPKT / sistem iDEAL; Lampiran A, B, B1; Jadual J & Jadual K / Schedule J & K; e-KYC, CTOS). Refinance, top-up and reschedule tracked on the same loan file. Standard = branch; Pro = nationwide apps + digital licence readiness. FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/truesyariah — TrueSyariah™ Shariah lending platform Malaysia for the KPKT Syariah Digital Lending Licence — Tawarruq commodity financing, Ta'widh & Gharamah ledgers, on-prem Trustgate signing, e-KYC, web/iOS/Android apps, dedicated AWS Malaysia. Separate Shariah entity/licence from conventional KPKT digital lending. FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/trueidentity — TrueIdentity™ e-KYC API: MyKad OCR, liveness, biometrics, PDPA-aligned, Malaysia-hosted; part of Truestack Core™; FAQ.
- https://www.truestack.my/truessm — TrueSSM™ SSM registry API: free entity search, ROC/ROB/LLP profiles, officers, shareholders, scanned documents, RM pricing, idempotent pulls; FAQ.
